items.text: You get the 4 % bonus only after 20 approved monthly deposits and when you take an ASP loan or a regular home loan to buy a home. The 1 % interest is credited every 31 December.
Saving the 20 deposits does not by itself earn the bonus. A loan for buying a home is also required, and the bonus is paid in arrears.
In practice, a pause just means it takes longer to reach 20 deposits. The deposits do not need to be in a row.
You can put in anything from 50 up to 1,500 euros each month, and your 400 euro monthly saving fits that.
Under the PS rules, payments up to 5,000 euros are deductible in 2026, but from 2027 the deduction ends.
If you hold 5,000 euros or less in PS on 1 January 2027, you can take it out in one go in 2027 or 2028 without the higher tax rate, though normal 30 % tax on the gain still applies.
The limit is not the same for both purposes: 5,000 euros caps the yearly deduction, and 5,000 euros on 1 January 2027 decides the lump-sum option.
Minors aged 15 to 17 have to phone Nordea with a guardian. Adults can open online or in the app.
I can not tell from the account page whether your bank will approve a loan, so check with Nordea.
ASP is a home savings account. It has a 1 % annual interest, a 4 % bonus after conditions, and a 14 day cancellation right when opened online.
If you withdraw before then and you have no special reason, the higher tax rate applies.
The 10 % savings share applies only when you apply for an ASP loan.
